lowHp.text: Hey, hey, slow down! These Pokémon are brand new, {player}!

firstDown.text: Already?! Fine, fine, that one was just warming up!

lastPokemon.text: Last one! No more messing about, let's wrap this up fast!

lowHp.text: No, no, no! I ran the whole way here for this!

firstDown.text: Tch! I'll make up for that one double, just watch!

lastPokemon.text: My partner since day one! Show {player} what we've got!

lowHp.text: Hang in there! We can't lose before Hearthome, we just can't!

firstDown.text: Huh! You've been training on the sly, haven't you?

lastPokemon.text: Okay, this is it! All or nothing, {player}!

lowHp.text: Come on, come on! Don't you quit on me now!

firstDown.text: Gah, that one hurts! But I'm only just getting started!

lastPokemon.text: My last one! If this doesn't work, I'll... I'll think of something!

lowHp.text: We are not losing on this bridge! Not here, not to you!

firstDown.text: Ha! That's the {player} I know! But I'm not done yet!

lastPokemon.text: Last one! Everything I've got goes into this, {player}!

lowHp.text: Hold on! We came too far to stop right at the League's door!

firstDown.text: Ow! You never let up, do you? Good! Neither do I!

lastPokemon.text: Down to my last! Funny, it always comes to this with you!

lowHp.text: Not yet! One more hit, that's all I need!

firstDown.text: A crack in the rock... You hit harder than you look.

lastPokemon.text: My last stone. Let's see if you can break bedrock.

lowHp.text: Steady now... Rock holds firm until the very last blow.

firstDown.text: Oh, my poor sprout! Don't worry, the rest of my garden's tougher!

lastPokemon.text: My prettiest bloom is last! Isn't she lovely? And she bites!

lowHp.text: Wilting? No way! Grass always grows back!

firstDown.text: You're strong... No! I won't doubt myself. Not today.

lastPokemon.text: This is my partner. Together, we don't back down!

lowHp.text: My hands are shaking... but my heart isn't!

firstDown.text: OOF! A clean pin! The crowd loves it! But the match goes on!

lastPokemon.text: The main event! My champion of the ring steps in!

lowHp.text: Down on the mat? Not while I'm still roaring!

firstDown.text: Ah! A misstep in our dance... How very exciting!

lastPokemon.text: And now, the finale! My star takes the stage!

lowHp.text: Such passion! You make my heart spin, but we will not bow yet!

firstDown.text: Ha! Not bad at all! My boy said you had some grit!

lastPokemon.text: My last wall of steel! Come on, give it everything!

lowHp.text: Dented, maybe! But steel doesn't fold, kid!

firstDown.text: Whoa, nice one! Okay, okay, time to focus up!

lastPokemon.text: Last one! She's the coolest girl in Snowpoint, just watch!

lowHp.text: Brrr... We're still in this! Stay focused, stay frosty!

firstDown.text: Huh. That actually woke me up a little.

lastPokemon.text: My last one. Don't let the spark go out now, okay?

lowHp.text: Yeah... This is the battle I've been waiting for.

firstDown.text: Ugh, seriously? A kid like you?!

lastPokemon.text: Fine! My cutie will teach you some manners!

lowHp.text: This is SO annoying! Just give up already!

firstDown.text: Again with you?! You're getting on my last nerve!

lastPokemon.text: I won't lose to you twice! Not in front of the boss's lake!

lowHp.text: No, no! Cyrus is counting on me!

firstDown.text: Don't think you've won! The boss is right behind us!

lastPokemon.text: Last one, but it only takes one to stop you!

lowHp.text: We're so close to a new world... Don't you dare ruin it!

firstDown.text: Heh. Still as stubborn as ever, aren't you?

lastPokemon.text: Last one. Let's see if you've still got it.

lowHp.text: You know what? This is more fun than any order I ever followed.

firstDown.text: Hmph. A little luck goes a long way, doesn't it?

lastPokemon.text: Enough games. My partner ends this now.

lowHp.text: You really don't know when to quit, do you?

firstDown.text: Cute. But you're already far too late.

lastPokemon.text: Last one. It's more than enough for the likes of you.

lowHp.text: Tch... Cyrus's dream won't be stopped by a child.

firstDown.text: Well. You haven't gone soft, I'll give you that.

lastPokemon.text: My last. Let's finish what we started all those months ago.

lowHp.text: Heh... Losing to you is starting to feel familiar.

firstDown.text: I see. Your strength is not an accident.

lastPokemon.text: My last Pokémon. I'll treat this with the care it deserves.

lowHp.text: Interesting. You may yet be the one who stops us.

firstDown.text: As expected. Then I'll stop holding back.

lastPokemon.text: Last one. Whatever happens next, I'll accept it.

lowHp.text: Perhaps... perhaps this is how it should end.

firstDown.text: Your Pokémon fight hard for you. How very inefficient.

lastPokemon.text: My last. Show me what that spirit of yours is truly worth.

lowHp.text: Even now, I feel nothing. That is my strength.

firstDown.text: You've grown. It changes nothing.

lastPokemon.text: My last Pokémon. A single piece is all a plan needs.

lowHp.text: Emotion is a flaw. And yet you lean on it so...

firstDown.text: Even here, where nothing is whole, you will not give way.

lastPokemon.text: The last. The world I seek lies past you, and I will reach it.

lowHp.text: Why... Why does a spirit like yours refuse to break?

firstDown.text: Oh, my dear bug! It fought so bravely for me...

lastPokemon.text: My last one. Even the smallest wing can carry a storm!

lowHp.text: Don't give up! Bugs never stop, not even when they're cornered!

firstDown.text: Oh my! You hit like a landslide, young one.

lastPokemon.text: My last. Granny still has some strength left in her, you'll see.

lowHp.text: Ho ho! It's been ages since anyone shook my ground like this!

firstDown.text: Yeah! Now THAT is some heat! Keep it coming!

lastPokemon.text: My last flame! Let's see whose fire burns brighter!

lowHp.text: Burning low, but never out! Never!

firstDown.text: Hm. This chapter turns out differently from what I'd read.

lastPokemon.text: The last page. Let us see how your story ends.

lowHp.text: Remarkable. I could not have predicted this.

firstDown.text: Wonderful. You and your Pokémon truly trust one another.

lastPokemon.text: My last Pokémon. I've rarely had to call on it... Let's go.

lowHp.text: This is it... the battle I've been hoping for. Don't hold back!
